title: Implement role-oriented Home and Classes destinations with C&S accessible-class selection
verify: FT-007-AC-002: /home and /classes consume server-resolved actor and Center & Scheduling scope to present Admin own-center, Teacher assigned-class, and Student/Parent accessible-calendar destinations.
Unauthenticated, revoked, cross-center, cross-class, non-member, and removed-assignment requests fail before protected destination data renders.
Both routes are read-only adapters, never reconstruct provider scope, and pass their own disposable browser role/scope matrix.

The C&S accessible-class query supplies the complete server-authorized Student/Parent destination list for bare canonical routes; it returns only C&S-owned class facts and remains separate from AC-009 registry metrics/profile composition.

evidence: Fresh verifier-owned probe passed 1 file / 6 tests for C&S accessible-class enumeration, bare /home and /classes, non-expanding classId filtering, Admin/Teacher scope, denial and removed-assignment paths, non-mutation, provider ownership, and destination owners.

Independent provider and route gates passed 1/1 and 13/13; disposable browser E2E passed 1/1 with exact database/sidecar cleanup; full suite passed 62 files / 204 tests; check, build, diff, mb-lint, and strict doctor passed.
Attempt 1 evidence and the historical semantic-fail remain preserved as supporting correction history; the current report contains exactly one VERDICT: PASS.
Fresh T3 adversarial review passed the current provider/route probes and two independent Codex Luna xhigh co-reviews after bounded recovery, with no material finding or operator question.

Coverage confirmed complete authorized Student/Parent enumeration, no scope expansion from caller classId, Admin/Teacher mappings, denial/revocation/cross-center/non-member paths, request-local actor use, provider/destination ownership, and no route database access or writes.
The current protocol and report each contain exactly one SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass; prior semantic-fail remains preserved as historical correction evidence.

verify.judge: JUDGE_ASSESSMENT: SUPPORT; trajectory_signal: progress; recommended_route: scheduler closure and canonical sequential W29 selection

evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-002 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: the C&S accessible-class query is absent or route-owned, bare /home or /classes over-denies an authorized Student/Parent, trusts caller-selected scope, omits an allowed destination, exposes unauthorized center/class data, or permits removed assignment; GREEN: isolated C&S provider and route tests plus owned-server browser tests prove the complete bare-route role/scope matrix, safe denial, no provider bypass, and non-mutation; artifact: .tasks/TASK-080-T3-FT-007-W29/ and .protocols/TASK-080-T3-FT-007-W29/.
purpose: Deliver the accepted Home/Classes role-oriented navigation outcome as one server-scoped implementation result, including the C&S-owned accessible-class selection needed by bare canonical routes.
success_outcome: Each supported role can open /home and /classes and see only the center/class destinations currently authorized by server boundaries; Student/Parent bare routes receive the complete accessible class list from C&S without caller-selected authorization.
anti_goals: Do not implement Statistics, Profile, or provider formulas.
Do not read Center & Scheduling tables directly from routes, return Identity & Access profile fields or metric fields from the accessible-class query, or claim AC-009 registry ownership.
Do not add a role, membership, assignment, or client authority.
constraints: Center & Scheduling owns the accessible-class enumeration/list selection; both pages are thin adapters over that server-resolved destination scope and together own AC-002.
The existing class calendar and class-entry routes remain destination owners.
The C&S extension is a read-only public query over existing membership, parent-link, assignment, and class facts; it does not change source ownership or introduce a new graph edge.
Browser proof reuses TASK-079's executable runner but proves only this task's role/scope result.
invariants: Server actor, center membership, class membership, and assignment are decisive.
Bare Student/Parent routes enumerate only the classes returned by the server-resolved C&S accessible-class query; no arbitrary first class or caller-supplied classId is authorization.
Removed assignment is denied at the next request without unrelated data disclosure.
Home and Classes add no writes; routes do not access provider tables, and the C&S query returns no profile or metric facts.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-002: C&S accessible-class enumeration plus Admin/Teacher/Student/Parent positive destinations, bare canonical /home and /classes access, and cross-center/class, non-member, revoked, and removed-assignment negatives on both routes.

stop_conditions: Stop if the accessible-class query requires a new capability slice, graph edge, source-of-truth owner, role, membership, assignment, or authorization rule beyond the accepted Calendar and Membership Query Boundary.
Stop if either route must select authorization locally, read provider tables, or if the query returns profile, attendance, payment, or composed registry fields.
Stop if browser proof cannot remain disposable.
